account: The four edge cells are fully specified with concrete coordinates and target solution sets. The acceptance condition is mechanical: for each (x,y) cell, compute R = 1/2 - 1/x - 1/y exactly, verify the z-interval, and for each z in the interval solve (ab)w = a+b with a = R-denominator relation, enumerate factor pairs, and accept iff the listed solutions match. All arithmetic is exact integer arithmetic and no external sources are needed. The node can be decided locally in one bounded computation.
